en: Bats are mammals that have fur and feed their babies with milk instead of laying eggs.
Plants make their own food using sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide through photosynthesis instead of eating soil.
Whales are marine mammals that breathe air through lungs instead of extracting oxygen through gills like fish.
Spiders are arachnids with eight legs, whereas true insects have six legs and three body segments.
Frogs are amphibians that start their life cycle breathing underwater with gills before developing lungs.
Mushrooms are fungi that absorb nutrients from decaying matter instead of making food via photosynthesis like plants.
Human blood is always red, appearing bright red when oxygenated and dark red when deoxygenated.
Human bones are living organs made of living cells that constantly grow and repair themselves.
Butterflies undergo complete metamorphosis, transforming inside a chrysalis from a crawling caterpillar into a flying adult.
Wild penguins live exclusively in the Southern Hemisphere, primarily in Antarctica, rather than the Arctic.
Most snake species, like the harmless Philippine reticulated python, are non-venomous and kill prey by constriction.
Many bacteria are beneficial, helping humans digest food and producing essential vitamins in our intestines.
